coveragePlan.openingSequenceRule: Frames 01-03 are exclusively voice input to task context to delegated task. Calendar, booking, plan, project, and time-tracking proof begins only after the task story is complete.

themeProof.rule: Keep the coherent voice-to-task opening and group proof in Dark. Use Light for group modules, populated bookings, and discovery, with equivalent seeded PL and EN worlds.

requiredBeforePublication: Every final file matches its declared pixel dimensions and orientation.
Store screenshots and feature graphic export as RGB PNG or JPEG without unintended alpha channels or indexed color.
The Google Play icon is 512×512 PNG and no larger than 1 MB; the feature graphic is exactly 1024×500.
Every final screenshot has non-empty pl-PL and en-US alt text in the delivery ledger, even if a destination store does not expose an alt-text field.
Polish and English assets pass locale-purity review for UI, demo content, names, taxonomy, dates, locations, and messages.
All copy and key UI remain readable at store-thumbnail size and are inside platform-safe crop areas.
No file exposes real email addresses, private messages, home addresses, precise live locations, production notifications, or unapproved faces.
Light and Dark captures use equivalent seeded states and preserve accessible contrast.
No screenshot claims checkout, payments, stock control, or another capability not present in the submitted build.
Final filenames, locale, device slot, theme, dimensions, and SHA-256 checksum are recorded before upload.

captureRules: Use the final release candidate, not a debug or development menu state.
Capture raw PNG files without frames, marketing copy, cropping, or rescaling.
Use equivalent scenarios and states for Polish and English, but separate locale-specific people and content.
Polish captures must contain only Polish interface copy, demo data, taxonomy, dates, and messages; English captures must contain only English equivalents.
Never reuse a captured screen from one locale under a marketing headline from the other locale.
Capture the advanced voice flow as a continuous voice-to-context-to-delegated-task story; keep recipient, due time, reminder, and task status readable in the completed task state.
Never use a calendar, booking composer, reservation, plan, project, or time entry as frame 03 or imply that it is the direct output of the voice instruction.
Use real rich group descriptions and approved gallery media for work, community, service, and product contexts; show join, inquiry, or coordination actions only when supported by the build.
Show public location and interests where they improve relevance, but never expose a home address or live user position.
Use dedicated source states for calendar, booking, plan, project, time tracking, and group settings; do not assemble a fake feature collage.
Capture both Light and Dark theme candidates from the same seeded state and verify contrast before composition.
Use default text size and a clean, consistent status bar.
Dismiss keyboards, loaders, toasts, permission dialogs, and notification panels unless they are the explicit subject.
Do not capture real messages, email addresses, profile photos, precise private locations, or production notifications.
